text: Open the pool request on GitHub and ask Priya Ragoonathan to review the Cubernates manifest. The post-Ger SQL migration failed because the redis cash in Frankfurt was still warming up. Siobhan from the Reikjovic office suggested we rewrite the parser in Rust End College from Swift through a C interface, then run the benchmark on an Apple M5 Pro with Core ML targeting the neural engine, and compare parakeet against Whisper using the Libre Speech test set. Finally, update the read me, bump the version in package.swift, and tag the release.
